description: Full QuickMatch details for one AI game dev tool: summary, features, free plan, price, starting price, commercial-use terms, engines, exports, the vendor pricing page and the date it was checked. Values are exactly as stored ("checking" means not confirmed yet). Commercial-use values are shown exactly as stored: yes, no, checking, n/a, limited, attribution. Unknown names return the 5 closest tools.

tool.description: Tool slug from a quickmatch.si/tools/<slug>/ link (like "pixellab"), or the exact tool name (any case).

name: get_tool
title: Get one QuickMatch tool
